questions.q: With no flags, on a supported NVIDIA card with a recent PyTorch, is dynamic VRAM on?
questions.why: enables_dynamic_vram is true unless one of five flags says otherwise, and main.py then checks support.

questions.q: What does --highvram do besides keeping models on the card?
questions.why: It is one of the flags in enables_dynamic_vram's list.

questions.q: You pass --lowvram with dynamic VRAM on. What happens?
options: Nothing: its help says it does nothing then
The text encoder always moves to the CPU
questions.answer: Nothing: its help says it does nothing then
questions.why: That is in the flag's help text, in cli_args.py.

questions.q: With 16 GB of system RAM and no cache flag, how much RAM does the cache try to keep free?
questions.why: 10% is 1.6 GB, and main.py applies a minimum of 2 GB.

questions.q: What happens if you pass --use-sage-attention and --use-flash-attention together?
options: Both run, one after the other
questions.why: They are in one mutually exclusive group, and we ran the parser to confirm.
